name: agy-game-studio
description: End-to-end 2D game development studio for Go and Ebitengine with live 60 FPS WASM Playtest tab, 10-second DVR GIF bug annotation, Sound Editor procedural audio (.music & .sfx) synthesis, and Sprite Editor 2D sprite & tileset design (.sprite & .aseprite) in Game Dev Studio.
suggestedPrompts: Design and build a 2D arcade game in Go with Ebitengine and launch it in Game Dev Studio
Open Game Dev Studio to playtest my Ebitengine game and capture a 10s DVR GIF bug report
Open the Sound Editor in Game Dev Studio to compose chiptune BGM or design procedural sound effects with live waveform and spectrum analysis
Open the Sprite Editor in Game Dev Studio to design procedural 2D sprites, tilesets, and frame animations and export to .aseprite
